text: Every morning the small bakery on the corner opens its doors at seven. The smell of fresh bread drifts down the street, and people stop on their way to work to buy a warm loaf or a cup of coffee. The baker knows most of them by name. She asks about their children, their gardens and their plans for the weekend. On rainy days the queue reaches the door, but nobody seems to mind waiting a few minutes for something made with care.
